text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members meet for a short standup to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to release working software quickly, gather feedback, and improve the product step by step.
